scientific_integrity: Self-contained uniform proof uses explicit clique classification, free-face collapses and cellular attachments; finite exact calculations corroborate and separately prove the n=18 obstruction.
scientific_limitations: The integral homotopy and symmetry theorem is for integers n at least nineteen at inclusive vertex-metric radius two.
The boundary n=18 is only a mod-two homology obstruction, not a homotopy classification.
The natural dihedral subgroup action is computed; full automorphism and larger-radius filtrations are not classified.
Equivalent unpublished or unindexed research cannot be ruled out; external independent assessment has not been performed.
title: Persistent hexagon spheres in generalized Petersen graph thickenings
